_doc: Asset pack split. Universal packs use the Linux x86_64 export preset (no multi-variant content); per-platform packs build once per entry in `platforms`. Pack names + includes here MUST match the corresponding 'Asset Pack - <name>[ (<platform>)]' entries in export_presets.cfg.
_platforms_doc: Web is intentionally absent — Godot's web export texture-format selection is GPU-cap-driven at runtime; bootstrap.gd falls through to linux-x86_64 for unmatched platforms. Add web here once we have a reliable preset.
